object.description: Setup: three saved workouts, one with heart rate, a storage provider that accepts writes. Steps: 1. Select the export row in Settings. 2. Choose a save location. 3. Unpack the written file. 4. Validate each GPX file against the GPX 1.1 schema. 5. Compare the JSON file with the Workout Detail screen of each workout. Expected: One ZIP file is written at the chosen location without a storage permission prompt. It holds 3 GPX files with 0 schema errors, one per workout, and one JSON file holding the workout figures, splits and heart rate figures of the 3 workouts, equal to the values shown.
